consequence.statement: A warning message logged at controller and webhook startup is removed; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: The "Neither --kubeconfig nor --master was specified" warning log message is no longer emitted when the controller and webhook services boot; it has no operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-969cbf095c23] lists this under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)" and says only that a startup warning log message is no longer emitted by the controller and webhook. Nothing in it says that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, and nothing says the --kubeconfig or --master flags changed. A log line disappearing is a cleanup with no operational consequence, so kind "none" (informational) is the right consequence.
